rows.grounds: genitive dependent indicating the domain of the god
locative compound indicating direction and portion; internal compound boundary at +
past participle describing the goddess's location

items.question: In which part of the god's domain is the supreme goddess situated?
premises: The domain belongs to the god.
A northeast part of that domain is specified.
The supreme goddess is situated there.
items.inference: The supreme goddess is located in the northeast part of the god's domain.
uncertainties: The identity of devasya as a specific deity or a general referent is not explicit in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: But the supreme goddess is situated in the northeast part of the god's domain.
